slice: P2 AC1027 MLINE offset-only style retarget with cap-suppression flags
scope: Permit selected AC1027 MLINE group-340 style retargets where target style offsets change, start/end angles and element arity remain fixed, and MLINE group-71 open consumers optionally suppress start/end caps. Reproject each consumer's group-41 miter-distance parameters while preserving group-71 flags and existing endpoint/interior miter directions.

specEvidence.group41: Element parameters describe per-element segment intersections, starts and cuts. Cap suppression is carried separately in group 71.
specEvidence.interpretation: Preserving documented cap flags while recalculating offset-dependent group-41 parameters is qualified for this selected offset-only retarget. Native cap rendering is not independently verified.

contract.admission: AC1027 only. The selected route requires open, unfilled, uncut MLINE consumers; group-71 values 1, 5, 9 and 13 are admitted, where 5/9/13 mean start-cap suppression/end-cap suppression/both. Closed value 3 and unknown-bit value 17 refuse. The source and target MLINESTYLE geometry flags remain 2, angles remain 90/90, and the same two style elements remain in the same order. This does not enable cap flags for direct consumed-style edits, append, removal, other retarget geometry, or other versions.
contract.projection: Runtime-authored source styles have offsets [1.25,-0.75]; the target changes the first offset to 1.5 while preserving the second, flags and 90/90 angles. Two source-bound MLINE consumers (one ENTITIES and one BLOCKS) retain positions, vertex directions, miters, group-71 flags and the redundant group-2 name. The authoritative group-340 reference changes to the target style; group-41 values are recomputed from target offsets and original miter directions.
contract.outputAndReadback: Twelve positive combinations cover flags 5, 9 and 13 across ASCII/binary input and output. Physical output checks group 71, exact group-340 target references, target style offsets, redundant names, endpoint miter coordinates and group-41 values for both consumers. A fresh typed readback checks target style identity/offsets and consumer flags, geometry and references.
contract.failureAndRetry: Closed and unknown group-71 profiles each refuse for both ASCII and binary output while preserving a destination sentinel and caller state; the same writer then succeeds with a corrected flags-13 source. A late consumer-parameter mutation refuses atomically for both output encodings and succeeds on the same adapter after restoring caller state.
contract.compatibility: The nondefault group-71 admission is gated to AC1027 offset-only style retargets with unchanged angles, equal style flags and unchanged arity. Existing plain-open consumed-offset, angle-retarget, append and removal behavior remains separately gated. No drawing fixture was added; all sources are generated in the test temporary directory.

sourceBindings.fixtureRecipe: retargetRecipe in tests/dxf_fixture_tests.cpp writes the MLINE and MLINESTYLE source records at runtime; output proof decodes physical records and freshly imports the serialized file.

focusedSelectors.summary: 3/3 passed in 1.51s. The retarget-offset selector covers 12 positive cap-flag encoding profiles, 4 closed/unknown refusals with corrected-source retry, and 2 late-mutation refusals with same-adapter retry; adjacent consumed-offset and angle-retarget selectors also pass.

validation.asan: NOT_RUN; this slice adds no new allocation, ownership, lifetime, bounds or handle path.

limitations: Only AC1027 and the selected two-style, two-element, two-consumer offset-only retarget profile are covered.
Cap flags are preserved and read back, but native cap appearance and rendered geometry are not qualified.
Direct consumed-style edits with cap flags, cap-flag append/removal, changed angles, other flags, versions, complete-document closure and support claims remain outside this receipt.
next: Select one current source-backed richer MLINE style/consumer schema or alternate LTYPE provider, identify its actual refusal/loss and owning dependency, and implement one bounded output/readback/refusal/retry profile.
